description: This file provides a safe API for operating on /proc on Linux, wrapping internal procfs APIs and managing procfs handles with safety considerations.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: A wrapper around an *os.File handle to /proc, providing methods to safely operate on /proc filesystem.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the resources associated with the Handle.

methods.name: OpenProcRoot
methods.description: Opens a safe handle to /proc with optional subset=pid mount option.

methods.name: OpenUnsafeProcRoot
methods.description: Opens an unsafe handle to /proc without overmounts or masked paths.

methods.name: OpenThreadSelf
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/thread-self/<subpath> for the current thread.

methods.name: OpenRoot
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/<subpath> for global procfs files.

methods.name: OpenPid
methods.description: Returns a handle to /proc/<pid>/<subpath> for other processes.
